the absorption of organic liquids is influenced by the molecular size, shape, polarity and hydrogen bonding capacity of the liquid, as well as the solubility parameter of the polymer and its degree of crystallinity.
the absorption of liquids into PEEK is affected by the molecular size, shape and polarity of the liquids.
the diffusion of organic liquids in PEEK is affected by the size of the liquid molecules, the shape of the molecules and the polarity of the molecules.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the diffusion of small organic molecules in polyaryl ether-eterketone (PEAK) and its carbon-fibre reinforced form, PEEK.
the absorption of liquids into polymeric materials, and in particular, the effects of molecular shape and size, and the polarity of the solvent.
the absorption of organic liquids into carbon fibre reinforced PEC laminates.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the diffusion coefficient of a liquid in a polymer matrix is dependent on the molecular shape and size and polarity of the liquid.

the diffusion of organic liquids through the PEEK matrix is dependent on the size and shape of the molecules, the hydrogen bonding capacity, the solubility parameter, and the crystalline structure of the PEEK matrix.
the absorption of organic liquids is dependent on molecular shape, size and polarity.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the absorption of organic liquids into PEEK is controlled by three important parameters (size, shape, and hydrogen bonding capacity).

the rate of absorption of liquids by PEEK depends strongly on molecular structure and that the rate of diffusion of liquids in PEEK is not a simple linear function of the product of the molar volumes and solubility parameters of the liquid and the polymer.
the rate and extent of absorption are dependent on the chemical structure of the liquid, with the size, shape and polarity all having important effects.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the absorption of liquids into a polymer is not only dependent upon the chemical structure of the liquid and the polymer but also upon the crystalline morphology of the polymer.
solvent absorption is a complex process which is influenced by many parameters, and which can be understood by considering the interactions between the solvent molecules and the polymer chains.
the diffusion of liquids in PEEK is strongly affected by molecular size and shape, as well as polarity, and that the effects of these parameters are additive.
